rules.sentence: Patients with HIV-related Kaposi sarcoma respond well to HAART,[21][22] which can cause regression or complete treatment of their sarcoma.
In patients with severe Kaposi sarcoma, combines HAART with chemotherapy.[23]
Iatrogenic Kaposi sarcoma treatment must balance a reduction in immune suppression or withdrawal of steroid treatment with transplant rejection and treatment of the sarcoma.[9]
